HOTEL DEEPA

Luxury Redfined
Welcome to the Hotel Deepa Comforts, your ideal heaven for business, conference, banquets, leisure, vacation and celebration. Our three-star hotel combines comfort, convenience, and contemporary amenities to cater to the diverse needs of our guests, where each individual is given service with unobtrusive consideration and care. The commitment to impeccable service expresses itself in the meticulous attention to detail in the coordination of everything from business appointments to travel arrangements.
The Hotel is fully equipped for business class travelers with Wi-Fi internet access, three exclusive food and beverages outlets, luxurious banquet halls to conduct your various business meetings to memorable events, travel desk and 24 hours room service. Our courteous staff works round the clock managing the most demanding requirements of our guests. Our continuing efforts towards quality makes us distinguished among the hotels in Mangalore.
Mr. Ramesh Kumar & Mrs. Urmila Ramesh Kumar
Message from the Managing Directors
Mr. Ramesh Kumar, Managing Director of Hotel Deepa Comforts is a distinguished property developer and hospitality magnate with an impressive career spanning over 40 years. As a prominent figure in Mangalore's real estate and hospitality industry, he has constructed over 35 Apartment buildings and commercial places in and around Mangalore. Mr. Kumar has established himself as a dedicated and accomplished individual with a proven track record of excellence.
Mr. Kumar's entrepreneurial spirit led him to establish Janatha Constructions and its affiliated companies, which have carved a niche for them in Mangalore's real estate landscape. His foray into the hospitality industry began with the launch of Hotel Deepa Comforts in 2008, a 3-star hotel that has become a benchmark for excellence in Mangalore.
Mrs. Urmila Ramesh Kumar had begun her professional journey in the nationalized bank, where she developed her skills and gained valuable experience. Subsequently, she transitioned to the hospitality industry, assuming the role of Managing Director at Hotel Deepa Comforts, her commitment to excellence is evident in her various roles, including her current positions as President of Vishwa Billava Mahila Sangha and Vice President of Kudroli Shree Gokarnanatha Kshethra in Mangalore.
Under Mr. & Mrs Kumar's leadership, Hotel Deepa Comforts has earned a reputation for its high-quality food, prompt and personalized service, immaculate atmosphere, and affordable pricing. The hotel's commitment to excellence has been recognized through numerous awards and accolades from both state and national governments. Their legacy continues to inspire and influence the next generation of entrepreneurs and business leaders.
Welcome to Hotel Deepa Comforts, where luxury meets comfort and exceptional service. We are delighted to introduce our hotel as your home away from home.
At Hotel Deepa Comforts, we strive to provide an unforgettable experience for our guests. Our team is dedicated to ensuring that every moment of your stay with us is nothing short of extraordinary. From our elegantly designed rooms to our world-class amenities, every detail has been carefully crafted to exceed your expectations. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, we invite you to indulge in our warm hospitality and unparalleled service. Explore our website to discover more about our hotel, and we look forward to personally welcoming you to Hotel Deepa comforts soon.
